content_sections.heading: REC Limited Advisor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
content_sections.text: Notification Date: 22 July 2026 Last Date to Submit Application: 15 August 2026, till 6:00 PM Cut-off Date for Age and Experience: 15 August 2026 (last date of submission)

content_sections.heading: REC Limited Advisor Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any category-wise reservation breakup for these posts.

content_sections.heading: REC Limited Advisor Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Advisor (Green Hydrogen): B.E./B.Tech or M.Tech in Chemical, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (full-time courses only), or equivalent. Advisor (Compressed Biogas - CBG): B.E./B.Tech or M.Tech in Chemical, Environmental or Mechanical Engineering, BBA, or B.Sc. (Hons) in Agricultural Business Management (full-time courses only). For Advisor (Green Hydrogen): Total 30 years of experience, with at least 10 years in Production, Planning, or Designing of Hydrogen Plants or other emerging renewable energy (RE) technologies. Expertise in electrochemistry, process optimization, and thermodynamic modelling preferred. Experience evaluating large infrastructure or industrial projects from a technical and commercial perspective. For Advisor (Compressed Biogas - CBG): Total 30 years of experience, with at least 10 years in Production, Planning, or Designing of Biogas Plants or other emerging RE technologies. Experience evaluating large infrastructure or industrial projects from a technical and commercial perspective. For Advisor posts: individuals retired/separated at the level of E-9 and above from a CPSE, or JS level and above in the Government of India, with total experience of not less than 30 years - or others with an equivalent profile and CTC (at a minimum of the pay scale of E-9 grade in REC). Maximum 65 years as on the last/closing date of application, i.e., 15 August 2026.

content_sections.heading: REC Limited Advisor Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: Monthly remuneration for both Advisor posts is ₹2,00,000/-, along with other benefits as per Corporation policy.

content_sections.heading: REC Limited Advisor Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify a detailed multi-stage selection process. Candidates are required to submit their application/CV with supporting documents, following which shortlisting will be carried out by REC Limited. The notification states that no correspondence will be entertained with candidates who are not shortlisted or selected.

content_sections.text: Application/CV in the prescribed Application Format Proof of age Proof of qualification (self-attested) Proof of experience (self-attested) Details of last drawn pay, including level/grade and/or CTC as applicable (self-attested) Recent passport-size colour photograph Grade and pay scale structure of the present/last organization (CTC last drawn) - required enclosure as per the application format Relieving order and last pay slip from the last served organization (to be produced at the time of selection)

content_sections.heading: REC Limited Advisor Recruitment 2026 - Scope of Work (Terms of Reference)
content_sections.text: As per Annexure A of the notification, the Advisors will assist REC in appraisal, technical due diligence, and risk assessment of projects proposed for financing. Assessing market demand, supply trends, pricing outlook, and growth potential for Green Hydrogen, Green Ammonia, and related derivatives Reviewing policy, regulatory framework, and industry developments Evaluating project configuration, technology (electrolysers, purification, compression, storage), and infrastructure adequacy Assessing project costs, EPC strategy, offtake arrangements, and financial viability/bankability Identifying technical, commercial, regulatory, and operational risks with mitigation measures Providing due diligence reports, monitoring reports, and independent technical opinions Assessing market demand, pricing outlook, and growth potential for CBG and related bio-energy products Reviewing feedstock availability, anaerobic digestion technology, gas upgrading, and compression systems Evaluating project costs, feedstock and offtake arrangements, and financial viability/bankability Identifying feedstock, regulatory, environmental, and operational risks with mitigation measures Assessing storage, bottling, dispensing, and City Gas Distribution (CGD) connectivity infrastructure Providing due diligence reports, monitoring reports, and independent technical opinions

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for REC Limited Advisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 15 August 2026, till 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for REC Limited Advisor posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 65 years as on the closing date of application, i.e., 15 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for REC Limited Advisor (Green Hydrogen/CBG) posts?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is ₹2,00,000/-, plus other benefits as per Corporation policy.

faq.question: Q4. Is REC Limited Advisor recruitment 2026 a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, for 6 months, extendable based on the Corporation's requirement, and does not entitle any candidate to claim regular or permanent employment.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply for REC Limited Advisor posts?
faq.answer: Individuals retired/separated at the level of E-9 and above from a CPSE, or JS level and above in the Government of India, with at least 30 years of total experience — or others with an equivalent profile and CTC at a minimum of the E-9 pay scale in REC.
